blurb: They provide manual lymphatic drainage and therapeutic bodywork for pre and post surgical recuperation, lymphedema management, cancer treatment support, plastic surgery support, and whole body wellness. Services are offered both mobile and in a studio located in Browns Valley Plaza, West Napa. The team includes certified and experienced therapists specializing in lymphatic massage and post-surgical recovery.
